roadmap.title: Base story and first-pass unlocks
roadmap.description: Clear the six base regions from Kyushu to the Tower of London while picking up the level, hot spring, divine gear, forge, barber, refashion, disguise, Twilight, Chaos, Nue, Derrick, Hiragumo, bonfire, dungball and Hyottoko unlocks on the way.

roadmap.title: Base collectibles and companion clean-up
roadmap.description: Finish the 150 Kodama, 20 hot springs, 40 gestures, 22 Guardian Spirits and the full yokai roster, recruit Muramasa, and clear ten missions with an NPC or co-op partner.

roadmap.title: Weapon mystic arts and blacksmith work
roadmap.description: Push one weapon to maximum proficiency, reach 500,000 with the other base weapons and clear their dojo mastery missions, earn the Ninjutsu and Onmyo mystic arts, and gather every best smithing material.

roadmap.title: Dragon of the North (Tohoku)
roadmap.description: Enter Tohoku after the base story, clear its three main missions, collect its Kodama and hot springs, clear Aoba Castle's keeps, hear out Katakura Shigenaga, unlock the odachi mystic art, and finish Hands of the Dragon.

roadmap.title: Defiant Honor (Siege of Osaka, Winter)
roadmap.description: Clear The Siege of Osaka (Winter) and Scion of Virtue, collect the chapter's Kodama, hot springs and culverin kills, defeat the Ten Braves, clear The Sparrow Flies Again, and take the tonfa and twin-stick challenges.

roadmap.title: Bloodshed's End (Siege of Osaka, Summer)
roadmap.description: Clear the three Summer main missions, collect the chapter's Kodama and six hot springs, break the cannons and Revenant contraptions, drive off the Onmoraki, and descend to the 20th plane of The Abyss.

roadmap.title: New Game+ endgame and completion
roadmap.description: Return on Way of the Strong and later cycles to clear The Grand Tournament and The Master Ninja, assemble the sacred regalia, max divine equipment, finish the 60 blacksmith requests, and claim the last achievement.

achievements.description: You have unlocked all achievements!
achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in Nioh: Complete Edition.

guide.context: The Complete Edition achievement list covers the base game and all three DLCs. Nothing here is missable, and every mission can be replayed from the world map.

steps.text: Earn every other achievement in this guide; the platinum registers as soon as the last remaining Steam achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Completed "The Man with the Guardian Spirit".
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{The Man with the Guardian Spirit} in Kyushu to complete the opening story mission.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Man with the Guardian Spirit} on the Isle of Demons in Kyushu.

achievements.description: Completed "Deep in the Shadows."
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{Deep in the Shadows}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Deep in the Shadows} in Kyushu.

achievements.description: Completed "The Ocean Roars Again."
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{The Ocean Roars Again}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Ocean Roars Again} in Chugoku.

achievements.description: Completed "The Demon of Mount Hiei."
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{The Demon of Mount Hiei} to complete the Kinki story mission.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Demon of Mount Hiei} in Kinki.

achievements.description: Met with Tokugawa Ieyasu.
achievements.summary: Meet @npc{Tokugawa Ieyasu} during @loc{The Weight of the World} in Tokai.

steps.text: Progress through @loc{The Weight of the World} in Tokai until @npc{Tokugawa Ieyasu} appears in the story scene.

achievements.description: Witnessed Tokugawa's forces head toward a decisive battle.
achievements.summary: Leave Tokai for Sekigahara after @loc{The Defiled Castle} and watch Tokugawa's army march out.

guide.context: This plays automatically when you travel from Tokai toward the Sekigahara region; no Sekigahara mission has to be cleared first.

steps.text: After clearing @loc{The Defiled Castle}, select the Sekigahara region from the world map and let the cutscene play.

achievements.description: Completed "The Source of Evil."
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{The Source of Evil}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Source of Evil} in Sekigahara.

achievements.description: Completed "The Samurai from Sawayama."
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{The Samurai from Sawayama}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Samurai from Sawayama} in Omi.

achievements.description: Completed "The Demon King Revealed."
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{The Demon King Revealed}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Demon King Revealed} in Omi.

achievements.description: Completed "The Queen's Eyes."
achievements.summary: Complete the main mission @loc{The Queen's Eyes}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Queen's Eyes} in the Tower of London to finish the base story.

achievements.description: Made two circuits around Japan.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{The Queen's Eyes} and watch the epilogue in which William sails away from Japan.

guide.context: The achievement is tied to the ending of the base story rather than to a second playthrough.

steps.text: Defeat the final boss of @loc{The Queen's Eyes} and let the ending and epilogue cutscenes play out.

achievements.description: Reached level 10.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 10.

steps.text: Trade Amrita for levels at any shrine until the character total reaches 10.

achievements.description: Reached level 100.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 100.

guide.context: Amrita for level-ups comes from killing enemies and clearing missions, and the base story normally carries a character to level 100 on its own.

steps.text: Spend Amrita at shrines until the character reaches level 100.
If short, clear New Game+ missions for much larger Amrita payouts.

achievements.description: Reached maximum proficiency with your first weapon.
achievements.summary: Reach 999,999 proficiency with a single weapon type.

guide.context: Weapon proficiency rises from damage dealt and keeps accumulating even after a weapon's familiarity meter is full, so a single weapon can carry the whole run. Proficiency is viewable under Status > Additional Stats.

steps.text: Keep attacking with one weapon type throughout the playthrough so its proficiency climbs.
If it is still short, replay a high-level New Game+ mission such as @loc{Isle of Demons} and clear its enemies or fight the @enemy{Onryoki} boss repeatedly.
steps.note: Let @enemy{Onryoki} kill you before his health runs out so the fight can be repeated; beating him ends the mission.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the sword.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for the sword.

guide.context: Weapon mystic arts unlock only after 500,000 proficiency with that weapon and its dojo mastery mission; the weapon mastery missions appear once @loc{Immortal Flame} in Sekigahara is cleared.

steps.text: Fight with a sword until its proficiency reaches 500,000.
Clear the sword dojo mastery mission that appears.
Buy the sword mystic art in the skill menu with skill points.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the dual swords.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for the dual swords.

guide.context: Weapon mystic arts unlock only after 500,000 proficiency with that weapon and its dojo mastery mission; the weapon mastery missions appear once @loc{Immortal Flame} in Sekigahara is cleared.

steps.text: Fight with dual swords until their proficiency reaches 500,000.
Clear the dual sword dojo mastery mission that appears.
Buy the dual sword mystic art in the skill menu with skill points.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the spear.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for the spear.

guide.context: Weapon mystic arts unlock only after 500,000 proficiency with that weapon and its dojo mastery mission; the weapon mastery missions appear once @loc{Immortal Flame} in Sekigahara is cleared.

steps.text: Fight with a spear until its proficiency reaches 500,000.
Clear the spear dojo mastery mission that appears.
Buy the spear mystic art in the skill menu with skill points.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the axe.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for the axe.

guide.context: Weapon mystic arts unlock only after 500,000 proficiency with that weapon and its dojo mastery mission; the weapon mastery missions appear once @loc{Immortal Flame} in Sekigahara is cleared.

steps.text: Fight with an axe until its proficiency reaches 500,000.
Clear the axe dojo mastery mission that appears.
Buy the axe mystic art in the skill menu with skill points.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the kusarigama.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for the kusarigama.

guide.context: Kusarigama mystic arts unlock only after 500,000 proficiency with the weapon and its dojo mastery mission; the weapon mastery missions appear once @loc{Immortal Flame} in Sekigahara is cleared.

steps.text: Fight with a kusarigama until its proficiency reaches 500,000.
Clear the kusarigama dojo mastery mission that appears.
Buy the kusarigama mystic art in the skill menu with skill points.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for Ninjutsu.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for Ninjutsu.

guide.context: The Ninjutsu art needs 20 points in Dexterity, the three Ninja dojo trials, and @loc{A Defiled Holy Mountain} cleared; a Book of Reincarnation can move attributes into Dexterity for the chain and restore the build afterwards.

steps.text: Raise Dexterity to 20 attribute points.
Clear The Way of the Ninja: Novice, Adept and Veteran in the dojo.
Clear @loc{A Defiled Holy Mountain}, then clear @loc{A True Ninja} in the dojo.
Buy the Ninjutsu mystic art for 5 Ninja Skill Points.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for Onmyo Magic.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for Onmyo Magic.

guide.context: The Onmyo art needs 20 points in Magic, the three Onmyo dojo trials, and @loc{A Defiled Holy Mountain} cleared; a Book of Reincarnation can move attributes into Magic for the chain and restore the build afterwards.

steps.text: Raise Magic to 20 attribute points.
Clear The Way of the Onmyo: Novice, Adept and Veteran in the dojo.
Clear @loc{A Defiled Holy Mountain}, then clear @loc{A Greater Harmony} in the dojo.
Buy the Onmyo Magic mystic art for 5 Onmyo Magic Skill Points.

achievements.description: Used a disguise.
achievements.summary: Buy a transformation at the Hidden Teahouse and wear it.

guide.context: The Hidden Teahouse opens after clearing @loc{Spider Nest Castle}. Transformations are bought with glory, and the cheapest one, Hattori Hanzo, costs about 1,300 glory.

steps.text: Defeat revenants, the red graves found in missions, to earn glory.
Open the Hidden Teahouse from the map's starting point, choose Trade > Transform, buy the cheapest disguise and select Transform.

achievements.description: Changed your hair style or beard.
achievements.summary: Change your hairstyle or beard at the blacksmith's barber.

guide.context: The barber menu is unlocked with a single patronage point, earned by spending money at the blacksmith.

steps.text: Spend money at the blacksmith, then open Dialogue > I have a request and buy Unlock Barber Menu.
Open the barber and change either the hairstyle or the beard.

achievements.description: Changed the appearance of an item.
achievements.summary: Change the appearance of a piece of equipment.

guide.context: Refashioning copies the look of gear already owned and leaves its stats and weight unchanged, so light armour can be made to look heavy.

steps.text: At the blacksmith choose Refashion, pick the item to alter and the appearance to copy, then confirm.

achievements.description: Forged an item.
achievements.summary: Forge an item at the blacksmith.

steps.text: At the blacksmith choose Forge, select any recipe with the materials on hand and confirm.

achievements.description: Found Muramasa and brought him in.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{The Trail of the Master}, a Tokai side mission, to recruit Muramasa.

guide.context: Clearing this Tokai side mission brings the master blacksmith Muramasa into the blacksmith menu.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Trail of the Master} in the Tokai region.

achievements.description: Made a total of 60 requests at the blacksmith.
achievements.summary: Exchange 60 requests at the blacksmith.

guide.context: Requests are paid for with patronage points, which are earned by money spent at the blacksmith. Around 20 million must be spent in total, and spending on forging, reforging and soul matching all counts.

steps.text: Spend money at the blacksmith to build patronage points.
Open Blacksmith > Dialogue > I have a request and spend the points, repeating until 60 requests have been made.
If short on money, sell spare gear instead of discarding it and farm revenants in New Game+ for divine equipment to sell.

achievements.description: Collected all the best materials.
achievements.summary: Collect every highest-quality smithing material.

guide.context: The materials are the purple and green entries under Smithing Materials, obtained by disassembling gear, from enemy and boss drops, and as Twilight mission rewards.

steps.text: Disassemble spare weapons and armour for Tamahagane, Wood, Ingot, Lacquer, Leather Cord, Leather Kozane, Iron Kozane and Divine Fragment.

Farm Demon's Horn from large yokai, Writhing Tongue from @enemy{Onyudo}, Nue's Claw from @enemy{Nue} bosses, Kappa Shell from glowing @enemy{Kappa}, Spider's Leg Husk from @loc{Spider Nest Castle} spiders, Great Centipede's Fang from @enemy{Great Centipede} and Gargantuan Tail Bone from the @enemy{Gasha-dokuro} in @loc{The Source of Evil}.
Hunt Ogress Claw, Hank of Yokai Hair, Bangasa Rib, Raven Tengu Feather, White Tiger Fur and Umi-bozu's Eyestone through the matching Twilight missions and bosses.
Replay @loc{The Demon King Revealed} and defeat @enemy{Yamata-no-Orochi} a second time for Orochi Scale.

achievements.description: Completed 10 missions with NPC or in the “Yokai Realm with a companion” with other users.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 missions with an NPC companion or a co-op partner in the Yokai Realm.

guide.context: NPC escort missions count toward the total, so the achievement can be farmed entirely offline; online co-op is optional.

steps.text: Repeatedly clear an NPC companion mission such as @loc{Greater Demon Hunting} in Kinki or @loc{Master of the Twin Blades} until ten clears are logged.
Alternatively, play ten Yokai Realm missions through the Torii Gate with another player.

achievements.description: Communicated with a yokai 10 times.
achievements.summary: Communicate with a yokai 10 times using gestures.

guide.context: Only @enemy{Nurikabe} walls and @enemy{Mujina} tricksters respond. A Nurikabe accepts one of three gesture colours, blue, yellow or red, and the correct colour is randomised for each playthrough.

steps.text: Use gestures in front of a @enemy{Nurikabe} until it accepts one and vanishes, then quit the mission with a Himorogi Fragment.
Replay the mission and repeat until ten successful communications are recorded.
Answering a @enemy{Mujina} with the exact gesture it copies also counts as a communication.

achievements.description: Confused an enemy for the first time.
achievements.summary: Inflict Confusion on an enemy by stacking two different elemental effects.

guide.context: One elemental debuff is not enough; a second, different element must land while the first is still active so the two combine into Confusion.

steps.text: Apply a first elemental effect to a durable enemy with an elemental weapon buff, amulet or spell.
While it is active, apply a different element, such as another amulet type or a Living Weapon of another element, until Confusion triggers.

achievements.description: Completed your first Twilight mission.
achievements.summary: Complete a Twilight mission.

guide.context: Twilight missions appear as red-eye markers on the left of the world map and rotate daily; the lowest-level ones are the safest to start with.

steps.text: Select any Twilight mission from the world map and clear it.

achievements.description: Bathed in first hot spring.
achievements.summary: Bathe in your first hot spring.

guide.context: Hot springs restore health and grant a healing buff; bathing is saved the moment it happens.

steps.text: Step into any hot spring and press the interact button to bathe.

achievements.description: Obtained first divine item.
achievements.summary: Obtain your first divine item.

guide.context: Divine gear is coloured green and begins dropping after the @enemy{Yamata-no-Orochi} battle at the end of the base story, then throughout New Game+.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Yamata-no-Orochi} at the end of @loc{The Demon King Revealed} to receive divine drops, or play New Game+ missions until one drops.

achievements.description: Defeated all types of yokai.
achievements.summary: Defeat one of every small and large yokai type.

guide.context: Large yokai are the story bosses and cannot be missed. The only rare small yokai are @enemy{Karakasa Umbrella} in @loc{The Ogress} and @enemy{Mudman} in @loc{The Defiled Castle}. In co-op the killing blow must be yours for the kill to register.

steps.text: Clear every main and side mission, defeating the enemies you meet and every story boss.
Open Titles > Gameplay Record > Small and Large Yokai Defeated, cross-reference Amrita Memories > Yokai Illustrations and hunt any missing type in the mission listed for it.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring from the Kyushu Region to the Omi Region.
achievements.summary: Bathe in all 20 hot springs from Kyushu to Omi.

guide.context: Each bath saves on contact, so a mission can be quit right after bathing and revisited later; all missions are replayable.

steps.text: Kyushu: bathe in @loc{Deep in the Shadows} and @loc{The Spirit Stone Slumbers}.
Chugoku: bathe in @loc{The Silver Mine Writhes} and @loc{The Ocean Roars Again}.
Kinki: bathe in @loc{Spider Nest Castle}, @loc{Falling Snow} and @loc{The Demon of Mount Hiei}.

Tokai: bathe in @loc{Memories of Death-Lilies}, @loc{The Iga Escape} and the seven baths inside @loc{The Trail of the Master}, including the pair that counts as two and the pair in one top-floor room.
Sekigahara: bathe in @loc{Immortal Flame}.
Omi: bathe in @loc{The Samurai from Sawayama}, @loc{A Defiled Holy Mountain} and @loc{The Demon King Revealed}.

achievements.description: Acquired 40 gestures.
achievements.summary: Acquire 40 gestures.

guide.context: The gestures owned at the start of the game count, and the rest come from mission rewards or can be bought with glory at the Hidden Teahouse.

steps.text: Complete main and side missions to collect the gesture rewards they hand out.
If still short, defeat revenants for glory and buy additional gestures from the Hidden Teahouse.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama from the Kyushu Region to the Omi Region.
achievements.summary: Collect all 150 Kodama across the six base-game regions.

guide.context: Each region holds 25 Kodama and none are missable. Mission select shows the count for that mission, Gameplay Record > Other shows total progress, and the @npc{Shinka} Guardian Spirit can reveal nearby Kodama.

steps.text: Kyushu: @loc{Isle of Demons} 9, @loc{Deep in the Shadows} 8, @loc{The Spirit Stone Slumbers} 8.
Chugoku: @loc{The Silver Mine Writhes} 9, @loc{The Three Angry Gods} 4, @loc{The Ocean Roars Again} 9, @loc{The Conspirators} 3.
Kinki: @loc{Spider Nest Castle} 9, @loc{Falling Snow} 8, @loc{The Demon of Mount Hiei} 8.
Tokai: @loc{The Iga Escape} 8, @loc{Memories of Death-Lilies} 7, @loc{The Defiled Castle} 6, @loc{The Trail of the Master} 4.
Sekigahara: @loc{Immortal Flame} 9, @loc{Sekigahara} 7, @loc{The Source of Evil} 5, @loc{The Watcher in Darkness} 4.
Omi: @loc{A Defiled Holy Mountain} 9, @loc{The Samurai from Sawayama} 9, @loc{The Demon King Revealed} 7.

achievements.description: Collected all Guardian Spirits.
achievements.summary: Collect all 22 Guardian Spirits.

guide.context: Every Guardian Spirit is a main- or side-mission reward; the final one is dropped by the story's last boss when the base game ends.

steps.text: Complete every main and side mission and claim each Guardian Spirit reward along the way.
Defeat the final boss in @loc{The Queen's Eyes} to receive the last Guardian Spirit.

achievements.description: Became Ryunoshin the dung lover's best friend.
achievements.summary: Give 30 dungballs to Ryunoshin in @loc{The Defiled Castle}.

guide.context: Ryunoshin waits behind a door near the mission's second shrine. Noble Dungballs count for more than one normal dungball, so they shorten the farm.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{The Defiled Castle}, kill the four @enemy{Mudman} enemies in the water, then rest at the shrine to respawn them.
Keep farming until the dungballs on hand add up to 30 normal dungballs' worth.
Carry them upstairs to Ryunoshin and hand them over in packs of five until he gives you the Horned Turban Kabuto.

achievements.description: Used the mask of an ugly fellow to defeat an enemy.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a Hyottoko Mask.

guide.context: The mask has to be equipped in a shortcut slot, and its fire breath only reaches about two metres, so the target must be weakened and standing close.

steps.text: Obtain a @item{Hyottoko Mask} from the completion reward of @loc{Wreathed in Flame}, a corpse in @loc{The Conspirators}, or the Hidden Teahouse for 220 glory.
Assign the mask to a shortcut slot, weaken a nearby enemy, then trigger it so the fire breath lands the killing blow.

achievements.description: Lit all three evil-warding bonfires in Itsukushima.
achievements.summary: Light the three evil-warding bonfires in @loc{The Ocean Roars Again}.

guide.context: The mage beside the first shrine hands over Flint. Lighting all three fires prevents @enemy{Umi-bozu} from summoning minions in the boss fight.

steps.text: Take the Flint from the mage by the first shrine.
Light the bonfire close to the mission start.
Light the bonfire reached by going through the @enemy{Nurikabe} wall.
Reach the third bonfire by climbing the ladder on the right, passing behind the second shrine and descending the ladder on the left.

achievements.description: Collected all fragments of the Hiragumo teakettle from Shigisan.
achievements.summary: Collect all six Hiragumo teakettle fragments in @loc{Spider Nest Castle}.

guide.context: Each fragment is dropped by a large spider that bursts from a glowing web. The first two webs are on the critical path, and replaying the mission restarts the whole set.

steps.text: Break the first two webs on the route through the castle and kill the spiders they release.
Break the web in the spider cave below the hole by the house for the third fragment.
Shoot the web on the watchtower after the cave for the fourth fragment.
Break the web on the hill beyond the gate and third shrine for the fifth fragment.
Break the web on the hill past the burning wheel foe, before the large building, for the sixth fragment.

achievements.description: Defeated the Nue of Mount Hiei.
achievements.summary: Defeat the optional @enemy{Nue} in @loc{The Demon of Mount Hiei}.

guide.context: This @enemy{Nue} has no on-screen health bar and is the same enemy fought in @loc{The Spirit Stone Slumbers}. A hot spring sits close by for healing before the fight.

steps.text: Find the optional @enemy{Nue} in @loc{The Demon of Mount Hiei} and defeat it.

achievements.description: Defeated Derrick the Executioner.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Derrick the Executioner} in the basement of @loc{The Queen's Eyes}.

guide.context: Derrick is hidden off the main route, at the second shrine closest to the prologue arena.

steps.text: At the second shrine of @loc{The Queen's Eyes}, take the stairs down into the basement.
Defeat @enemy{Derrick the Executioner}.

achievements.description: Completed "Yokai Country."
achievements.summary: Complete the Tohoku main mission @loc{Yokai Country}.

guide.context: The Tohoku region opens once the base story ends with @loc{The Queen's Eyes}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Yokai Country} in Tohoku.

achievements.description: Completed "The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle."
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle}, Tohoku's second story mission.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle} in Tohoku.

achievements.description: Completed "Spirit Stone Huntress."
achievements.summary: Complete the Tohoku main mission @loc{Spirit Stone Huntress}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Spirit Stone Huntress} in Tohoku.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama in the Tohoku region.
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Kodama in the Tohoku region.

guide.context: Tohoku's 25 Kodama are split across its missions, and none are missable; mission select shows how many remain in each.

steps.text: @loc{Yokai Country}: collect 10 Kodama.
@loc{The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle}: collect 6 Kodama.
@loc{A Gilded Deception}: collect 9 Kodama.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the odachi.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for the odachi.

guide.context: The odachi arrives with the Dragon of the North content, and its mystic art needs 500,000 odachi proficiency and its dojo mastery mission.

steps.text: Fight with an odachi until its proficiency reaches 500,000.
Clear the odachi dojo mastery mission.
Buy the odachi mystic art with skill points.

achievements.description: Equipped +15 divine equipment in all slots. (Excludes accessories.)
achievements.summary: Equip divine gear enhanced to at least +15 in every weapon and armour slot.

guide.context: Accessories are excluded from the check. Divine drops scale up sharply in later New Game+ cycles, so the +15 threshold is reached naturally well before Way of the Wise.

steps.text: Play New Game+ and later cycles until divine gear at or above +15 drops for every slot.
Equip +15 or better divine items in the weapon and each armour slot, leaving accessories alone.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring in the Tohoku region.
achievements.summary: Bathe in all three hot springs in the Tohoku region.

guide.context: Each bath saves as soon as it is taken, so the mission can be left immediately afterwards.

steps.text: Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{Yokai Country}.
Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{A Gilded Deception}.
Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle}, inside the house guarded by a @enemy{Nurikabe}.

achievements.description: Completed any mission while transformed into a woman.
achievements.summary: Complete any mission while transformed into a woman.

guide.context: Female transformations at the Hidden Teahouse cost at least 70,000 glory, so earning that glory is the main hurdle.

steps.text: Earn 70,000 glory by defeating revenants or taking part in a clan battle.
Buy a female transformation at the Hidden Teahouse, apply it and clear any mission while wearing it.

achievements.description: Completed "Hands of the Dragon."
achievements.summary: Complete the Tohoku sub mission @loc{Hands of the Dragon}.

guide.context: @loc{Hands of the Dragon} opens after the Tohoku sub mission @loc{Become Thy Enemy}. It is a two-versus-one fight against @enemy{Date Shigezane} and @enemy{Katakura Shigenaga}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Become Thy Enemy} to unlock @loc{Hands of the Dragon}.
Defeat both bosses in @loc{Hands of the Dragon}.

achievements.description: Seized all of Aoba Castle's three-storied keeps in "The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle."
achievements.summary: Clear all four three-storied keeps in @loc{The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle}.

guide.context: A keep is cleared by killing the yokai on its top floor; clearing them also eases the first boss fight.

steps.text: Clear the tower behind the powder keg and gunner near the first shrine.
Clear the tower reached across the small lake.
Cross the bridge and clear the tower beyond it.
Clear any remaining three-storied keep in the castle until all four are done.

achievements.description: Listened to Katakura Shigenaga's entire introduction in "The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle."
achievements.summary: Let @enemy{Katakura Shigenaga} finish his entire introduction in @loc{The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle}.

guide.context: The introduction plays before the first boss fight, so attacking early can cut it short.

steps.text: Reach the first boss arena in @loc{The One-Eyed Dragon's Castle} and let @enemy{Katakura Shigenaga} speak until his dialogue ends.
Then defeat him.

achievements.description: Completed the mission "The Siege of Osaka (Winter)."
achievements.summary: Complete the Winter main mission @loc{The Siege of Osaka (Winter)}.

guide.context: The Siege of Osaka (Winter) chapter opens after the Tohoku story missions are cleared.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Siege of Osaka (Winter)}.

achievements.description: Completed "Scion of Virtue."
achievements.summary: Complete the Winter main mission @loc{Scion of Virtue}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Scion of Virtue}.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama in the "Siege of Osaka (Winter)" chapter.
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Kodama in the @loc{Siege of Osaka (Winter)} chapter.

guide.context: The chapter's Kodama are split across three missions and none are missable.

steps.text: @loc{The Siege of Osaka (Winter)}: collect 10 Kodama.
@loc{Dance of the Yokai}: collect 9 Kodama.
@loc{Scion of Virtue}: collect 6 Kodama.

achievements.description: Acquired mystic art for the tonfa.
achievements.summary: Acquire the mystic art for the tonfa.

guide.context: The tonfa arrives with the Defiant Honor content, and its mystic art needs 500,000 tonfa proficiency and its dojo mastery mission.

steps.text: Fight with a tonfa until its proficiency reaches 500,000.
Clear the tonfa dojo mastery mission.
Buy the tonfa mystic art with skill points.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring in the "Siege of Osaka (Winter)" chapter.
achievements.summary: Bathe in all three hot springs in the @loc{Siege of Osaka (Winter)} chapter.

guide.context: Each bath saves immediately, so the mission can be exited right after using it.

steps.text: Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{The Siege of Osaka (Winter)}.
Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{Dance of the Yokai}.
Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{Scion of Virtue}.

achievements.description: Defeated Sarutobi Sasuke in the mission "The Siege of Osaka (Winter)" using only tonfa. (Cannot use a Visitor/Companion.)
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Sarutobi Sasuke} in @loc{The Siege of Osaka (Winter)} using only a tonfa.

guide.context: A visitor or companion disqualifies the run, and the restriction covers the whole mission, so no other weapon may land a hit.

steps.text: Equip a tonfa and enter @loc{The Siege of Osaka (Winter)} without a visitor or companion.
Reach @enemy{Sarutobi Sasuke} and defeat him without attacking with any other weapon.

achievements.description: Defeated Ganryu's Sasaki Kojiro using only Dual Wooden Swords. (Cannot use a Visitor/Companion.)
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Sasaki Kojiro} in @loc{Ganryu} using only Dual Wooden Swords.

guide.context: The Ganryu sub mission is in the Winter chapter and opens after the weapon mastery dojo missions. A visitor or companion disqualifies the run.

steps.text: Obtain Dual Wooden Swords, which commonly drop in the dual-sword dojo mastery mission.
Equip them, enter @loc{Ganryu} without a visitor or companion and defeat @enemy{Sasaki Kojiro} using only that weapon.

achievements.description: Used all the culverins in the mission "The Siege of Osaka (Winter)."
achievements.summary: Fire all three culverins in @loc{The Siege of Osaka (Winter)}.

guide.context: Each culverin needs a cannonball. Firing them breaks the fortress wall and stops the regular arrow volleys.

steps.text: Take the two cannonballs handed out by the NPC near the mission start.
Find the third cannonball on a corpse in the third area, up the ravine on the right behind the low wall opposite the stairs.
Fire each of the three culverins from its position opposite the wall towers.

achievements.description: Defeated all of Sanada's Ten Braves in "Scion of Virtue."
achievements.summary: Defeat all of Sanada's Braves in @loc{Scion of Virtue}.

guide.context: The Braves are the noticeably tougher human enemies spaced through the mission, and each says a line when defeated.

steps.text: Fight through @loc{Scion of Virtue} and kill every tough human enemy, including the sword-wielding Brave just past the shrine before the final boss.

achievements.description: Completed "The Sparrow Flies Again."
achievements.summary: Complete the Winter sub mission @loc{The Sparrow Flies Again}.

guide.context: @loc{The Sparrow Flies Again} opens after @loc{Scion of Virtue} and ends with three bosses in sequence, the last being @enemy{Date Masamune}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Sparrow Flies Again}, defeating each boss in turn.

achievements.description: Equipped the Kusanagi Tsurugi, Yasakani Magatama, and Yata Mirror.
achievements.summary: Equip the @item{Kusanagi Tsurugi}, @item{Yasakani Magatama} and @item{Yata Mirror} at the same time.

guide.context: The Kusanagi Tsurugi turns up among early divine drops and the Yasakani Magatama can be farmed from the corpse in @loc{The Trail of the Master}. The Yata Mirror is the rare piece, supplied by later New Game+ reward accessories or Abyss treasure rooms.

steps.text: Obtain the @item{Kusanagi Tsurugi} and the @item{Yasakani Magatama}, farming the corpse in @loc{The Trail of the Master} for the magatama if needed.
Obtain the @item{Yata Mirror} from later New Game+ reward accessories or an Abyss treasure room.
Equip all three accessories at once.

achievements.description: Completed "The Sanada's Resolve."
achievements.summary: Complete the Summer main mission @loc{The Sanada's Resolve}.

guide.context: The Siege of Osaka (Summer) chapter opens after the Winter story missions are cleared.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Sanada's Resolve}.

achievements.description: Completed "Resentment Unleashed."
achievements.summary: Complete the Summer main mission @loc{Resentment Unleashed}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{Resentment Unleashed}.

achievements.description: Completed "The Last Samurai."
achievements.summary: Complete the Summer main mission @loc{The Last Samurai}.

steps.text: Clear @loc{The Last Samurai}.

achievements.description: Bathed in every hot spring in the "Siege of Osaka (Summer)" chapter.
achievements.summary: Bathe in all six hot springs in the @loc{Siege of Osaka (Summer)} chapter.

guide.context: The Last Samurai holds two baths, and the other four are spread across the chapter's remaining missions.

steps.text: Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{The Sanada's Resolve}.
Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{Resentment Unleashed}.
Bathe in both hot springs in @loc{The Last Samurai}.
Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{Courage and Wisdom}.
Bathe in the hot spring in @loc{Guardian in the Shadows}.

achievements.description: Collected all Kodama in the "Siege of Osaka (Summer)" chapter.
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 Kodama in the @loc{Siege of Osaka (Summer)} chapter.

guide.context: The chapter's Kodama are split across three missions and none are missable.

steps.text: @loc{The Sanada's Resolve}: collect 10 Kodama.
@loc{Resentment Unleashed}: collect 9 Kodama.
@loc{The Last Samurai}: collect 6 Kodama.

achievements.description: Completed "The Grand Tournament" on Way of the Strong or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{The Grand Tournament} on Way of the Strong or higher.

guide.context: The gauntlet throws several human masters at you back to back, so New Game+ gear makes it far more forgiving.

steps.text: Set the mission difficulty to Way of the Strong or higher.
Clear @loc{The Grand Tournament}.

achievements.description: Completed "The Master Ninja" on Way of the Strong or higher.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{The Master Ninja} on Way of the Strong or higher.

steps.text: Set the mission difficulty to Way of the Strong or higher.
Defeat the mission's boss in @loc{The Master Ninja}.

achievements.description: Completed the 20th plane in The Abyss.
achievements.summary: Complete the 20th plane of The Abyss.

guide.context: The Abyss opens after the base story. Its entry floor sends you by boat to four planes, and each Kodama found there removes one debuff from the Crucible boss; continuing straight to the next floor leaves only one plane to visit.

steps.text: Enter The Abyss, take the four boats and collect the Kodama in each plane to clear the Crucible's debuffs.
Defeat the Crucible boss, then choose to continue to the next floor instead of leaving.
Repeat the process until the 20th plane is cleared, using Catwalking and Suppa ninjutsu to run past enemies and a Living Weapon for the bosses.

achievements.description: Destroyed all the destructible cannons in "The Sanada's Resolve."
achievements.summary: Destroy all five destructible cannons in @loc{The Sanada's Resolve}.

guide.context: Four cannons explode when a nearby powder barrel is shot. The fifth is loaded by a barrel-carrying yokai that must be baited into position first.

steps.text: Shoot the powder barrels beside four of the cannons to destroy them.
Lure the barrel-carrying yokai in front of the fifth cannon and detonate its barrel.

achievements.description: Defeated the Onmoraki during "Resentment Unleashed."
achievements.summary: Drive off the @enemy{Onmoraki} during @loc{Resentment Unleashed}.

guide.context: The @enemy{Onmoraki} appears before the mission's boss and flees once it has taken enough hits rather than dying.

steps.text: When the large bird appears in @loc{Resentment Unleashed}, hit it with a firearm or bow until it flees.

achievements.description: Destroyed all the Revenant contraptions on "The Last Samurai."
achievements.summary: Destroy all four groups of Revenant contraptions in @loc{The Last Samurai}.

guide.context: The contraptions are yellow crystal door-like structures that spawn @enemy{Amrita Fiend} and @enemy{Magatsu Warrior} enemies. They do not respawn, so each group is a single attempt.

steps.text: Destroy the first contraptions along the mission route.
Destroy the pair of contraptions found in the small arena area that spawns enemy waves.
Destroy the remaining contraptions before the final boss, bursting each down with a prepared Living Weapon.
